details:
This update for ImageMagick fixes the following issues:

- CVE-2026-116148: command injection via unvalidated drawing options in MVG encoder (bsc#1288782).
- CVE-2026-116154: denial of service via XML parsing memory leak (bsc#1288789).
- CVE-2026-116157: denial of service via memory leak in PerlMagick (bsc#1288792).
- CVE-2026-119124: denial of service via heap-based buffer overflow in `-morph` option (bsc#1289086).
- CVE-2026-106580: policy bypass in CUT encoder (bsc#1284680).
- CVE-2026-116140: security policy bypass via flawed delegate invocation parsing (bsc#1288121).
- CVE-2026-116141: denial of service via policy bypass in UHDR decoder (bsc#1288734).
- CVE-2026-116142: heap buffer overread when specifying a minimum-bounding-box (bsc#1288735).
- CVE-2026-116143: denial of service via scene selection policy bypass (bsc#1288736).
- CVE-2026-116144: denial of service via uncontrolled recursion in MVG decoder (bsc#1288738). 
- CVE-2026-116145: policy bypass due to an incomplete fix of GHSA-jjp4-3fwf-393j (bsc#1288743).
- CVE-2026-116146: denial of service via MSL decoder memory leak (bsc#1288745). 
- CVE-2026-116147: denial of service via unchecked memory allocation in DJVU decoder (bsc#1288781).
- CVE-2026-116149: memory corruption via crafted bzip2 compressed images (bsc#1288783). 
- CVE-2026-116150: denial of service via memory leak in FPX encoder (bsc#1288785). 
- CVE-2026-116151: denial of service via memory leak in JNG encoder (bsc#1288786).
- CVE-2026-116152: denial of service via memory leak in MAT decoder (bsc#1288787).
- CVE-2026-116153: denial of service via heap-based buffer overflow in convex-hull calculations (bsc#1288788).
- CVE-2026-116155: denial of service via crafted XMP profile memory leak (bsc#1288790).
- CVE-2026-116156: denial of service via memory leak in -set profile option (bsc#1288791).
- CVE-2026-116158: denial of service via memory leak in compare command (bsc#1288793).
- CVE-2026-116159: denial of service via memory leak in the -cdl option (bsc#1288794).
- CVE-2026-116160: denial of service via crafted image in X11 animate operation (bsc#1288796).
- CVE-2026-109258: denial of service via invalid memory free in fx operation (bsc#1285071).
- CVE-2026-109259: information disclosure via crafted TGA image (bsc#1285071).
- CVE-2026-109260: denial of service via memory leak in PNG encoder (bsc#1285071).
- CVE-2026-109261: denial of service via memory leak in GIF encoder (bsc#1285071).
- CVE-2026-109262: denial of service via memory leak in SVG encoder (bsc#1285071).
- CVE-2026-109263: denial of service via memory leak in YUV encoder (bsc#1285071).
- CVE-2026-109265: denial of service via malformed XMP profile (bsc#1285071).
- CVE-2026-109266: XML injection vulnerability in the CIP encoder (bsc#1285071).
- CVE-2026-109268: denial of service via use-after-free in PDF writer (bsc#1285071).
- CVE-2026-109269: information disclosure via crafted JPEG file (bsc#1285071).
- CVE-2026-109270: denial of dervice via memory leak in the -process option (bsc#1285071).
- CVE-2026-109271: denial of dervice via use-after-free in the WBINFO decoder (bsc#1285071).
- CVE-2026-109272: denial of dervice via crafted PostScript file (bsc#1285071).
- CVE-2026-109273: information disclosure via crafted PostScript file (bsc#1285071).
- CVE-2026-109274: security policy bypass via TOCTOU symlink race condition (bsc#1285071).
- CVE-2026-109275: code injection via crafted MVG file (bsc#1285071).
- CVE-2026-109276: denial of service via temporary file leak in JNG decoder (bsc#1285071).
- CVE-2026-109277: security policy bypass via `-script` operation (bsc#1285071).
- CVE-2026-109278: denial of service via memory leak in `wavelet-denoise` operation (bsc#1285071).
- CVE-2026-102635: information disclosure in the GIF decoder (bsc#1283768).
- CVE-2026-123273: infinite loop in the SVG decoder (bsc#1289692).
